eventLocation: Kanchipuram Periyar Nagar Bus Stand to Vengudi Bus Stand
eventDescription:
Each banyan tree is the shade of our city,
the life of our future,
and the breath of our next generation.
With heartfelt gratitude, we extend our sincere thanks and warm wishes to
Mr. Mohan, Coordinator of Kanchi Annachathiram,
who became a guardian of greenery by generously contributing
and personally planting the trees with his own loving hands.
